To hand out

The Eight Entities

Dracula

Brawn d8 · Nimble d10 · Sly d6 · Charm d12 · Wits d4

Charges: (3: one per use of an ability)

Signature: Mesmerize 1 charge

At a watched obstacle that doesn’t list Charm, roll Charm at a Difficulty 2 lower; Trouble still gets you caught. Only you get past, but the way out still takes everyone and a rescue frees every captive. Never in a chase. He bends a mind with a look.

Gift: Shape of the Night (Bat) 1 charge

Roll Nimble instead of the trait the obstacle calls for (in a chase, instead of the ground’s). He flits up to the window.

Perk: Hypnotic Eyes always on

On Charm rolls, the Monster shows only if it beats your trait die by 2 or more.

Castle Duty (default): Butler, who shops for silver, china and linen. Your trait die is one size bigger on your own rolls at a location whose item is that kind (never in a chase).

Weakness: Garlic. Always (from round 1): in any chase, from its first round to its end, your trait die is one size smaller. Every kitchen in town has some, and the mob knows it.

Tell: No Reflection. A store window shows everyone but him.

Spend a charge before rolling, on your own roll or a friend’s in the same place (in a local chase, only your own). One raise per roll. In a chase, any ability can be a raise. With no charges left you can still overdraw: Suspicion +2, on top of the roll’s other rise (once in a local chase; in the final flight, once, your trait die one size smaller from your next roll instead).

Frankenstein’s Creature

Brawn d12 · Nimble d8 · Sly d6 · Charm d4 · Wits d10

Charges: (3: one per use of an ability)

Signature: Brute Force 1 charge

Roll Brawn instead of the trait the obstacle calls for (in a chase, instead of the ground’s). Stronger than any man, it breaks what others pick.

Gift: Made, Not Born (Mountain Stride) 1 charge

At an obstacle that doesn’t list Nimble, roll Nimble at a Difficulty 2 lower; if it’s watched, Trouble still gets you caught. Only you get past, but the way out still takes everyone and a rescue frees every captive. Never in a chase. He bounds over walls the way he crossed the glaciers.

Perk: Tireless always on

Carrying doesn’t make your Nimble smaller.

Castle Duty (default): Handyman, who shops for tools and hardware. Your trait die is one size bigger on your own rolls at a location whose item is that kind (never in a chase).

Weakness: Fire. Soon (from round 3): in any chase, from its third round to its end, your trait die is one size smaller. Someone has to light the torches.

Tell: Head and Shoulders. He stands a head above the whole crowd, and no costume hides it.

Spend a charge before rolling, on your own roll or a friend’s in the same place (in a local chase, only your own). One raise per roll. In a chase, any ability can be a raise. With no charges left you can still overdraw: Suspicion +2, on top of the roll’s other rise (once in a local chase; in the final flight, once, your trait die one size smaller from your next roll instead).

The Mummy

Brawn d10 · Nimble d4 · Sly d6 · Charm d8 · Wits d12

Charges: (3: one per use of an ability)

Signature: Ancient Lore 1 charge

Roll Wits instead of the trait the obstacle calls for (in a chase, instead of the ground’s). It knew this trick three thousand years ago.

Gift: Secrets of the Tomb (Royal Bearing) 1 charge

At an obstacle that doesn’t list Charm, roll Charm at a Difficulty 2 lower; if it’s watched, Trouble still gets you caught. Only you get past, but the way out still takes everyone and a rescue frees every captive. Never in a chase. They still bow to a pharaoh.

Perk: Fear the Curse always on

If you’re fleeing alone when your local chase starts, its mob’s Difficulty is 1 lower (after the cap of 11). Nobody wants to get too close.

Castle Duty (default): Librarian, who shops for books and paper. Your trait die is one size bigger on your own rolls at a location whose item is that kind (never in a chase).

Weakness: A Loose Thread. Soon (from round 3): in any chase, from its third round to its end, your trait die is one size smaller. Once someone grabs a loose end, it all starts to unravel.

Tell: Dust and Spice. A trail of dust and a smell of old spices wherever it walks.

Spend a charge before rolling, on your own roll or a friend’s in the same place (in a local chase, only your own). One raise per roll. In a chase, any ability can be a raise. With no charges left you can still overdraw: Suspicion +2, on top of the roll’s other rise (once in a local chase; in the final flight, once, your trait die one size smaller from your next roll instead).

The Werewolf

Brawn d10 · Nimble d12 · Sly d6 · Charm d4 · Wits d8

Charges: (3: one per use of an ability)

Signature: Good Dog 1 charge

Take the Monster d10 as your second die without risking Suspicion: if it shows, that adds nothing. Anything else on the roll still raises Suspicion as usual. If the wolf shows, the crowd sees a very large dog.

Gift: The Wolf Within (Keen Nose) 1 charge

Roll Wits instead of the trait the obstacle calls for (in a chase, instead of the ground’s). It smells the way in.

Perk: Night Runner always on

If you’re fleeing alone when your local chase starts, it starts at Lead 2.

Castle Duty (default): Gardener, who shops for plants and seeds. Your trait die is one size bigger on your own rolls at a location whose item is that kind (never in a chase).

Weakness: Hounds. Soon (from round 3): in any chase, from its third round to its end, your trait die is one size smaller. Someone lets the hunting dogs out.

Tell: Eyebrows That Meet. Eyebrows that meet in the middle, and too much hair everywhere else.

Spend a charge before rolling, on your own roll or a friend’s in the same place (in a local chase, only your own). One raise per roll. In a chase, any ability can be a raise. With no charges left you can still overdraw: Suspicion +2, on top of the roll’s other rise (once in a local chase; in the final flight, once, your trait die one size smaller from your next roll instead).

The Invisible Man

Brawn d4 · Nimble d8 · Sly d12 · Charm d6 · Wits d10

Charges: (3: one per use of an ability)

Signature: Unseen 1 charge

Take the Monster d10 as your second die without risking Suspicion: if it shows, that adds nothing. Anything else on the roll still raises Suspicion as usual. When the Monster shows, there’s nothing to see.

Gift: A Scientist’s Tricks (Through the Gap) 1 charge

At an obstacle that doesn’t list Nimble, roll Nimble at a Difficulty 2 lower; if it’s watched, Trouble still gets you caught. Only you get past, but the way out still takes everyone and a rescue frees every captive. Never in a chase. He slips through as the door swings shut.

Perk: Out of Sight always on

Trouble at a watched obstacle doesn’t get you caught unless you, or anyone in the same place, carries loot or furniture. It still raises Suspicion. They can’t see you, but they can tell something is there.

Castle Duty (default): Tailor, who shops for cloth and costumes. Your trait die is one size bigger on your own rolls at a location whose item is that kind (never in a chase).

Weakness: Flour. Soon (from round 3): in any chase, from its third round to its end, your trait die is one size smaller. Someone throws a bag of flour, and there he is.

Tell: Bandages and Goggles. A wrapped head, dark goggles, a false nose, and a sneeze from nowhere.

Spend a charge before rolling, on your own roll or a friend’s in the same place (in a local chase, only your own). One raise per roll. In a chase, any ability can be a raise. With no charges left you can still overdraw: Suspicion +2, on top of the roll’s other rise (once in a local chase; in the final flight, once, your trait die one size smaller from your next roll instead).

A Ghost

Brawn d4 · Nimble d12 · Sly d10 · Charm d8 · Wits d6

Charges: (3: one per use of an ability)

Signature: Through the Wall 1 charge

At an obstacle that doesn’t list Sly, roll Sly at a Difficulty 2 lower; if it’s watched, Trouble still gets you caught. Only you get past, but the way out still takes everyone and a rescue frees every captive. Never in a chase. Not while you carry loot or furniture: nothing you carry passes through. It drifts in where there’s no door.

Gift: Haunting (Chill) 1 charge

Your trait die is one size bigger for this roll (a d8 becomes a d10; a d12 can’t go higher). A sudden cold, and fingers fumble.

Perk: Spectral always on

Group ways in don’t stop you: no roll and no action. If one is the location’s only obstacle, you take the item, and if the party picks the other way in, you’re still past. Not while you carry loot or furniture.

Castle Duty (default): Butler, who shops for silver, china and linen. Your trait die is one size bigger on your own rolls at a location whose item is that kind (never in a chase).

Weakness: Cold Iron. Always (from round 1): in any chase, from its first round to its end, your trait die is one size smaller. Horseshoes, railings, a poker from the fire: every street has some.

Tell: Cold Spot. Candles flicker and breath fogs wherever it drifts.

Spend a charge before rolling, on your own roll or a friend’s in the same place (in a local chase, only your own). One raise per roll. In a chase, any ability can be a raise. With no charges left you can still overdraw: Suspicion +2, on top of the roll’s other rise (once in a local chase; in the final flight, once, your trait die one size smaller from your next roll instead).

A Witch

Brawn d6 · Nimble d4 · Sly d10 · Charm d8 · Wits d12

Charges: (3: one per use of an ability)

Signature: Hedge Spell 1 charge

Your trait die is one size bigger for this roll (a d8 becomes a d10; a d12 can’t go higher). Old village magic: a muttered word, a pinch of salt, and luck leans her way.

Gift: Witchcraft (A Potion for That) 1 charge

Roll Wits instead of the trait the obstacle calls for (in a chase, instead of the ground’s). There’s a potion for everything.

Perk: Familiar’s Warning always on

When you arrive somewhere that gets a Tell check, alone or with others, a Tell goes off only if a second d6 also rolls 4–6. That covers everyone arriving with you. The cat warns you.

Castle Duty (default): Cook, who shops for food and drink. Your trait die is one size bigger on your own rolls at a location whose item is that kind (never in a chase).

Weakness: Rowan. Soon (from round 3): in any chase, from its third round to its end, your trait die is one size smaller. A sprig of rowan, an old charm against witches. Someone in every crowd has one.

Tell: A Black Cat. A black cat follows her everywhere and stares at people.

Spend a charge before rolling, on your own roll or a friend’s in the same place (in a local chase, only your own). One raise per roll. In a chase, any ability can be a raise. With no charges left you can still overdraw: Suspicion +2, on top of the roll’s other rise (once in a local chase; in the final flight, once, your trait die one size smaller from your next roll instead).

Jekyll & Hyde

Jekyll: Brawn d4 · Nimble d6 · Sly d8 · Charm d12 · Wits d10

Hyde: Brawn d12 · Nimble d10 · Sly d8 · Charm d4 · Wits d6

Charges: (3: one per use of an ability)

Signature: The Draught 1 charge

Before one of your rolls, change form: Jekyll to Hyde or back (each has its own dice). The new form lasts until the next draught. Each raid starts with Jekyll. When the Monster shows on one of Jekyll’s rolls, that roll stands and Hyde takes over straight after it, free, until a draught changes him back. He does even when an ability, his own or a friend’s, meant the Monster raised no Suspicion.

Gift: The Other Self (Doctor’s Bag) 1 charge

Your trait die is one size bigger for this roll (a d8 becomes a d10; a d12 can’t go higher). The right instrument for the job.

Perk: Practiced Hand always on

Changing back to Jekyll costs no charge.

Castle Duty (default): Librarian, who shops for books and paper. Your trait die is one size bigger on your own rolls at a location whose item is that kind (never in a chase).

Weakness: A Familiar Face. Soon (from round 3): in any chase, from its third round to its end, your trait die is one size smaller. Someone in the mob recognizes the good doctor.

Tell: The Wrong Hand. One hand a gentleman’s, the other hairy and knotted.

Spend a charge before rolling, on your own roll or a friend’s in the same place (in a local chase, only your own). One raise per roll. In a chase, any ability can be a raise. With no charges left you can still overdraw: Suspicion +2, on top of the roll’s other rise (once in a local chase; in the final flight, once, your trait die one size smaller from your next roll instead).
